label: Store
description: Provider-independent asynchronous interface for named collections of JSON documents identified by their id property.

document.description: A JSON-compatible object whose string id property identifies it within a collection.

schema.description: Validated Store metadata, named collections, and embedded document schemas.

get.description: Returns a defensive copy of a document, or null when its id does not exist.

returns.description: Promise resolving to a document copy or null.

list.description: Returns defensive copies of all documents in a collection in provider-defined order.

add.description: Creates and returns a document copy. A provider may generate id when omitted; an existing id is rejected.

returns.description: Promise resolving to the created document, including any generated id.

save.description: Creates or replaces the document identified by its required id and returns a defensive copy.

returns.description: Promise resolving to the saved document copy.

remove.description: Deletes a document by id and returns whether a document was removed.

returns.description: Promise resolving to true when a document was removed, otherwise false.
